# package model

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-s7comm/model"
```

Package model defines shared S7 data types used by client and wire.

It covers memory [Area](#type-area) codes and [Address](#type-address) values, [DeviceInfo](#type-deviceinfo) / [ConnectionInfo](#type-connectioninfo), CPU and protection enums, block metadata ([BlockInfo](#type-blockinfo), [BlockData](#type-blockdata)), and thin wrappers over [github.com/otfabric/go-s7comm/model/codec](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-s7comm/model/codec) for big-endian BOOL/BYTE/WORD/INT/DWORD/DINT/REAL/STRING conversion.

Types here are transport-agnostic value models; protocol I/O lives in client, framing in wire.

## Types

### type Address

```go
type Address struct {
	Area     Area
	DBNumber int // Only used for DB area
	Start    int // Byte offset
	Size     int // Number of bytes
}
```

Address represents an S7 variable address

### type Area

```go
type Area uint8
```

Area represents an S7 memory area

```go
const (
	AreaInputs  Area = 0x81
	AreaOutputs Area = 0x82
	AreaMerkers Area = 0x83
	AreaDB      Area = 0x84
	AreaCounter Area = 0x1C
	AreaTimer   Area = 0x1D
)
```

#### func (Area) String

```go
func (a Area) String() string
```

String returns the area code as a string

### type BitAddress

```go
type BitAddress struct {
	Area       Area
	DBNumber   int
	ByteOffset int
	BitOffset  int
}
```

BitAddress identifies a single S7 bit (e.g. DB1.DBX10.3 → DBNumber=1, ByteOffset=10, BitOffset=3). BitOffset must be in 0..7; invalid offsets are rejected by the client (no silent wrap).

### type ConnectionInfo

```go
type ConnectionInfo struct {
	Host          string
	Port          int
	LocalTSAP     uint16
	RemoteTSAP    uint16
	Rack          int
	Slot          int
	PDUSize       int // negotiated max S7 PDU payload (bytes), excluding TPKT/COTP
	MaxAmqCalling int
	MaxAmqCalled  int
}
```

ConnectionInfo contains a snapshot of the established connection and negotiated limits. Obtained from client.ConnectionInfo(); safe to read when connected. PDUSize is the negotiated maximum S7 PDU payload length in bytes (excluding TPKT/COTP framing).

### type DeviceInfo

```go
type DeviceInfo struct {
	OrderNumber      string // SZL 0x0011 index 1
	SerialNumber     string // SZL 0x001C index 5
	ModuleName       string // SZL 0x001C index 2
	PlantID          string // SZL 0x001C index 3
	Copyright        string // SZL 0x001C index 4
	ModuleType       string // SZL 0x001C index 7, module type name
	FWVersion        string // SZL 0x0011 index 7, "Vx.y.z"
	HWVersion        string
	CPUType          string // ModuleType when it names a CPU
	CPUFamily        string
	SystemName       string // SZL 0x001C index 1, name of the automation system
	MemoryCardSerial string // SZL 0x001C index 8
}
```

DeviceInfo contains identification information about an S7 device
